channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Health ministry questions reliability of vasculitis drug approval data
item.description: Tavneos was launched in Japan in 2022 after being approved by the ministry. Its package insert listed liver dysfunction as a serious side effect.

item.title: Japan life insurers’ bond-buying plans set to support JGBs
item.description: Insurers have been net buyers of superlong government bonds for four months, a trend strategists say could provide an anchor in upcoming auctions.

item.title: Two Japanese climbers missing in the Himalayas
item.description: The two Japanese nationals have been out of contact since Oct. 15 and local authorities have been searching for them.

item.title: Supplies of rare earth yttrium have ‘stalled,’ industry ministry official says
item.description: The official described a "supply-demand crunch," with the Financial Times reporting that Tokyo is months away from running out of the critical metal.

item.title: Japan is known for world-class events - but the Asian Games were chaotic
item.description: Hotel chaos, transport mishaps and diplomatic blunders cast a spotlight on organisers and the firm hired to deliver the games.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
